name: states_no_production_code_rule
pattern: NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST

name: test_economy_section
why: 4.4: which tests may exist, not only when they are written

name: test_economy_delete_rule
pattern: would not turn the test red
why: the delete test is the one rule that bans padding

name: journey_is_the_default_level
why: 4.15 (owner's rule): default level is the end-to-end journey; component only for a fault, race or timing; unit only for a many-valued rule

name: paths_mapped_before_scenarios
pattern: Every ending has a scenario, or a stated reason it cannot happen
why: 4.15: start from the behaviour, map every path to every ending first

name: spec_and_code_fixed_together
pattern: both are fixed in the same change
why: 4.15: a spec/code mismatch is a bug in one of them, never coded around

name: test_written_from_spec_first
pattern: before reading the code it will exercise
why: 4.15: a test written after reading the code proves the code, not the spec

name: both_directions_checked
why: 4.15: every scenario has a test and every test has a scenario, by CLI
